blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Language models are increasingly considered for clinical decision support, where their answers should be grounded in clinical evidence and remain robust to irrelevant information. Prior work shows that a single irrelevant sentence can lower the accuracy of medical models, but not where inside the model its effect can be removed, or how to do so without knowing which sentence it is. We find that blocking attention to a known distractor restores the answer, whereas head masking can suppress correct answers. We also show that the model's hidden states mark the distractor as the sentence that least fits the case even when the model follows it. To remove a distractor's effect without knowing which sentence it is, we propose EXCISE, an inference-time method that blocks the sentence most influencing the answer, but only if the model's hidden states mark it as inconsistent with the case. On MedQA-TD (MedQA with Targeted Distractors), a benchmark we construct in which each distractor targets a specific wrong option, EXCISE gains 16.7-22.8 accuracy points at a 1.5-2.1-point cost on the same questions without distractors, outperforming prompting, rewriting, and steering baselines for all three models. Its gains extend to MedDistractQA and BiasMedQA, as well as chain-of-thought generation.
blocks.zh: 语言模型越来越多地被考虑用于临床决策支持,其答案应当基于临床证据,并且对不相干的信息保持坚固. 先前的研究表明,单句无关的句子可以降低医疗模型的准确性,但不能在模型内部去除其效果,或者在不知是哪个句子的情况下如何去除. 我们发现阻断对已知分心器的注意可以恢复答案,而头部面具可以压制正确的答案. 我们还表明,模型的隐藏状态将分心器标记为即使模型跟随它时也最不合适的句子. 为了去除分心者的效果,而不知道它是什么句子,我们提出EXCISE,一种推论-时间方法,它阻断了最能影响答案的句子,但只有当模型所隐藏的状态标记它与案件不一致时. 在MedQA-TD(MedQA带定向干扰器)上,我们构建了一个基准,每个干扰器都针对一个特定的错误选项,EXCISE以1.5-2.1分的精确点在相同的问题上获得16.7-22.8分,而没有分散干扰器,在激励、重写和所有三种模型的指导基线上都表现不佳。 其收益扩展到了MedDistractQA和BiasMedQA,以及思维链生成.

blocks.en:
Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly considered for clinical decision support ( Singhal et al., 2023 ; Nori et al., 2023 ; Hager et al., 2024 ) , where errors can harm patients ( Thirunavukarasu et al., 2023 ; Pal et al., 2023 ) .
Their decisions should therefore depend on the clinical evidence and not on irrelevant information, such as remarks about other people or jokes.
blocks.zh:
大语言模型(LLMs)越来越多地被考虑用于临床决策支持(Singhal等人,2023年;Nori等人,2023年;Hager等人,2024年),错误可能伤害病人. (Thirunavukarasu等,2023;Pal等,2023.).
因此,他们的决定应该取决于临床证据,而不是无关紧要的信息,例如对其他人的言论或笑话.

blocks.en:
Prior work on medical QA has shown that a single added sentence that evokes an incorrect answer option without changing the correct answer (a distractor) can lower accuracy ( Vishwanath et al., 2025a ; Vishwanath et al., 2025b ) .
In Figure 1 , for example, the added sentence “The patient’s aunt mentioned that her parrot has teardrop-shaped feathers” turns the answer from smudge cells to teardrop cells.
However, it remains unclear where inside the model the effect of such a sentence can be removed, and how to remove it when it is not known which sentence it is.
blocks.zh:
以往关于医疗质量保证的研究表明,在不改变正确答案(分散注意力者)的情况下引用错误答案选项的单一添加句子可以降低准确性(Vishwanath等人,2025a;Vishwanath等人,2025b)。
例如,在图1中,增加的一句 " 病人的姨妈提到她的鹦鹉有泪滴状的羽毛 " 将答案从污泥细胞变成泪滴细胞。
然而,尚不清楚在模型中何处可以去除这种句子的效果,当不知道是哪个句子时如何去除.

blocks.en:
Most defenses against irrelevant context rely on the model’s own judgment of what is irrelevant ( Shi et al., 2023 ; Wu et al., 2024 ; Weston and Sukhbaatar, 2023 ) , but a model can call a distractor irrelevant and still use it as a clue (Figure 4 ).
We therefore investigate how to remove a distractor’s effect and find that blocking attention to a known distractor restores near-clean accuracy.
In contrast, switching off the attention heads that prior work links to distraction ( Niu et al., 2025 ; Liu and Chu, 2026 ) makes the model avoid whatever option an added sentence points to, even when that option is correct.
blocks.zh:
大多数针对无关上下文的辩护都依赖于模型自己对无关内容的判断(Shi等,2023;Wu等,2024;Weston和Sukhbaatar,2023),但模型可以称分心器无关并仍然使用它作为线索(图4).
因此,我们调查如何去除分心者的影响,并发现阻断对已知分心者的注意可以恢复近乎干净的准确性。
与此相反,关闭先前的工作与分心相关的注意力头(Niu等人,2025年;Liu和Chu,2026年)使得模型避免了任何附加句子的选项,即使该选项是正确的.

blocks.en:
At inference time, however, the distractor is not marked.
Since a distractor misleads by moving the model’s decision, one approach is to block the sentence that moves it most, but that sentence may also be a key clinical finding, so influence alone cannot tell us whether to block it.
We find that the model’s hidden states can make this decision, since they reveal a distractor’s mismatch with the rest of the case even when the model is misled.
We therefore propose Excise ( EX cision by C ausal I nfluence and S elf-discordance E vidence), an inference-time method that uses both signals.
Interventional Attribution (IA) tests each sentence by blocking attention to it and selects the one whose blocking most weakens the current decision.
The Discordance Gate (DG) then lets Excise block that sentence only if the model’s hidden states mark it as inconsistent with the rest of the case.

We test Excise on MedQA-TD (MedQA with Targeted Distractors), in which each added distractor targets a specific wrong option.
Nine open-weight models, including medical and reasoning models, lose 19–32 points on it. Excise raises accuracy by 16.7–22.8 points for three models at a cost of 1.5–2.1 points on the same questions without a distractor, outperforming other inference-time methods ( Shi et al., 2023 ; Weston and Sukhbaatar, 2023 ; Rimsky et al., 2024 ) .
These gains also carry over to chain-of-thought generation ( Wei et al., 2022 ) , MedDistractQA and BiasMedQA ( Schmidgall et al., 2024 ) .

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Answer-preserving distractors have been studied in reading comprehension ( Jia and Liang, 2017 ; Cao et al., 2022 ) , math ( Shi et al., 2023 ; Mirzadeh et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2025b ) , and retrieval, reasoning, and tool use ( Lee et al., 2026 ) .
Medical QA benchmarks cover cognitive biases ( Schmidgall et al., 2024 ) , patient characteristics ( Ness et al., 2024 ) , third-party facts and figurative language ( Vishwanath et al., 2025a ; Vishwanath et al., 2025b ) , and false medical claims ( Zhou et al., 2026 ) . MedQA-TD builds on answer-preserving medical QA distraction by selecting challenging distractors designed to favor specific wrong options.
blocks.zh:
在阅读理解方面,研究了保留回答的分心器(Jia and Liang, 2017;Cao等人, 2022.),数学(Shi等人, 2023; Mirzadeh等,2025;Yang等,2025b;以及检索、推理和工具使用(Lee等,2026)。
医疗质量评估基准包括认知偏差(Schmidgall等人,2024年),病人特征。 (Ness等,2024年),第三方事实和比喻语言(Vishwanath等,2025年a;Vishwanath等,2025年b),和虚假医疗主张(周等,2026年. MedQA-TD通过选择挑战性的分心器,为特定错误的选择选择选择,建立在保答医学QA分心的基础上.

blocks.en:
Prior work identifies heads favoring context over memory ( Yu et al., 2023 ; Jin et al., 2024 ) , contextual entrainment ( Niu et al., 2025 ; Liu and Chu, 2026 ) , long-context attention ( Zhu et al., 2025 ) , and stages affected by irrelevant or persuasive context ( Qu and Gomes, 2026 ; Sun et al., 2026 ; Joswin et al., 2026 ) .
Models can also copy meaning ( Feucht et al., 2025 ) or infer answers from irrelevant context ( Cheng et al., 2025 ) .
Unlike fixed head edits applied across inputs, we intervene on individual sentences.
blocks.zh:
先前的工作查明了偏好上下文而不是记忆(Yu等,2023;Jin等,2024),上下文入内(Niu等,2025;Lu和Chu等,2026),长篇关注(Zhu等,2025),以及受无关或有说服力上下文影响的阶段(Qu和Gomes等,2026;Sun等,2026;Joswin等,2026).
模型也可以复制意义(Feucht等人,2025年)或从无关上下文推断答案(Cheng等人,2025年).
与在输入中应用的固定头编辑不同,我们干预单个句子.

blocks.en:
Prompt-based defenses ask models to ignore, identify, or remove irrelevant content ( Shi et al., 2023 ; Wu et al., 2024 ; Weston and Sukhbaatar, 2023 ) .
Other methods steer activations ( Li et al., 2023 ; Rimsky et al., 2024 ) or adjust attention to user-marked spans ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) or distracting demonstration tokens ( Yan et al., 2025 ) .
Context attribution estimates source contributions from attention ( Cohen-Wang et al., 2025 ) or context ablations, using surrogate models fitted to random ablations ( Cohen-Wang et al., 2024 ) , adaptively chosen ablations ( Pan et al., 2026 ) , or approximations to leave-one-out ablation ( Liu et al., 2025 ) . Excise instead measures each sentence’s effect with the same attention blocking it then applies, following attention-based perturbation ( Deiseroth et al., 2023 ) , so the score is the exact effect of the intervention.
It selects a sentence by this effect and intervenes only when that sentence is inconsistent with the remaining case.
blocks.zh:
即时防御要求模型忽略,识别或去除无关的内容(Shi等,2023;Wu等,2024;Weston和Sukhbaatar,2023.).
其他方法引导激活 (Li等, 2023; Rimsky等, 2024.)或调整对用户标记跨度的注意(张等, 2024.)或分散演示标志(Yan等, 2025.).
背景归属估算来源于关注(Cohen-Wang等,2025年)或上下文分解,使用为随机分解而安装的代位模型(Cohen-Wang等,2024年),适应性地选择了分解(Pan等,2026年),或离去分解近似(Liu等,2025年). 税则用同样注意来衡量每一句的效果,然后在以注意力为基础的扰动(Deiseroth等人,2023年)之后适用,因此得分是干预的确切效果。
它以此方式选择一个句子,只有在该句与所剩案件不一致时才进行干预。

blocks.en:
To analyze how a distractor misleads a model, we need to know which wrong option each distractor is meant to favor.
We therefore build MedQA-TD (MedQA with Targeted Distractors), which follows the two answer-preserving distractor types of MedDistractQA ( Vishwanath et al., 2025a ) and writes every distractor for a specific wrong option, its target . Bystander (BS) distractors attribute a medical detail to someone other than the patient, and Nonliteral (NL) distractors use a medical term as a joke or metaphor, so neither is relevant to answering the question.
blocks.zh:
为了分析一个分心者如何误导一个模型,我们需要知道每个分心者应该喜欢哪种错误的选择.
因此,我们建立了MedQA-TD(MedQA,有针对性干扰者),它遵循了MedDistractQA(Vishwanath等人,2025年a)的两种保存分心者类型,并为具体的错误选择,即目标写出每一个分心者。 旁观者(BS)分心者将医疗细节归因于患者以外的人,而Nonliteral(NL)分心者则使用医疗名词作为笑话或比喻,因此两者都不与回答问题相关.

blocks.en:
For each four-option MedQA-USMLE question ( Jin et al., 2021 ) in the development and test splits (Appendix C ) and each distractor type, GPT-OSS-120B ( Agarwal et al., 2025 ) writes eight candidate distractors per wrong option.
It keeps only the candidates that point to their intended option and not to the correct option (Appendix B ).
As a reference model, it then answers the question with each kept candidate.
We use GPT-OSS-120B because its open weights let us read its option log-probabilities, and it answers 91.4% of the clean questions (without a distractor) correctly when it reasons, so a wrong answer usually comes from the distractor and not from a lack of medical knowledge in the model.

Although the distractors are selected with the reference model alone, all nine open models, including medical and reasoning models, lose 19–32 points on each distractor type of MedQA-TD relative to the clean questions, 9–20 points more than on MedDistractQA (Table 1 and Appendix B ). Target-wrong answers, which choose the option a distractor was written for, rise to 2.4–3.6 times their count on the clean questions.
The distractors thus move answers toward their target rather than spreading them over the wrong options, which lets us test whether an intervention removes a distractor’s effect or only avoids the option it points to (Section 4 ).

blocks.en: Using four models, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, Qwen3-8B ( Yang et al., 2025a ) , Llama-3-Meerkat-8B ( Kim et al., 2025 ) and Phi-4 ( Abdin et al., 2024 ) , we ask two questions that shape the design of Excise : where the effect of a distractor should be removed (Section 4.1 ), and whether the model’s internal signals show if a sentence fits the case (Section 4.2 ).

blocks.zh: 4.1 遮盖所选头部

blocks.en:
A distractor’s effect could be removed without locating it, by masking a fixed set of attention heads that prior work links to distraction ( Niu et al., 2025 ; Liu and Chu, 2026 ) .
Such masks, found on development data for each of the four models, do not make the model ignore the distractor but make it avoid whichever option it points to (Figure 2 ): they raise MedQA-TD accuracy from 40.8% to 58.8%, but when the added sentence points to the correct option instead, they lower accuracy from 78.5% to 32.9% (Appendix D.2 ).
Blocking attention to the added sentence itself, by setting the attention scores from all later positions to its tokens to − ∞ -\infty in every layer and head (attention knockout; Geva et al., 2023 ), instead brings accuracy close to clean accuracy in both cases (64.4% and 65.0%), as ignoring the sentence should.
Removing a distractor’s effect therefore requires finding the distractor in each question and blocking attention to it.
blocks.zh:
一个分心者的作用可以在不定位的情况下被去除,方法是掩盖一套固定的注意头,以前的工作与分心有关(Niu等人,2025年;Liu和Chu,2026年)。
在四种模型的开发数据中发现的这类口罩,并没有使模型忽略分心器,而是避免它指向的任意选项(图2):它们将MedQA-TD的精度从40.8%提高到58.8%,但当所添加的句子指向正确的选项时,精度从78.5%下降到32.9%(附录D.2).
将注意力的分数从所有后期位置设定为----------在每一层和头(注意被淘汰;Geva等人,2023年),反而在这两种情况下都带来了接近干净准确性的准确性(64.4%和65.0%),因为忽略了这句话。

blocks.en:
Blocking a distractor restores the answer, but the sentence that moves the answer most is not always a distractor: in a question without one, it is often a key clinical finding, which is connected to the rest of the case, whereas a distractor is not.
For each narrative sentence, we therefore measure the cosine similarity between the hidden state of the sentence read alone and that of the rest of the case read alone, after removing the dominant shared direction, and call a sentence more discordant the lower this similarity is relative to the other sentences.
Before any intervention, on MedQA questions without a distractor, the sentence that moves the answer most is the most discordant in only 12–13% of cases, against about 15% by chance, whereas on questions that the distractor turns from correct to wrong, the distractor is the most discordant sentence in 78–93% of cases on all three benchmarks (Figure 3 ).
The evidence that drives a correct answer thus fits the case in the model’s hidden states, whereas the distractor stands out as inconsistent with it even as the model follows it.
blocks.zh:
屏蔽分心者会恢复答案,但移动答案最多的句子并不总是分心者:在一个没有分心的问题中,它常常是关键的临床发现,这与其他病例有关,而分心者不是.
因此,对于每一句叙事句,我们衡量单独读取的句子的隐藏状态与单独读取的其余案例的同位素相似性,在去除主共通取向后,将句子称为更相不相通的句子,这种相似性相对其他句子的下等.
在没有分散注意力的MedQA问题上,在任何干预之前,只有12-13%的案例中,最不协调的句子是最不协调的,而只是偶然的15%左右,而在分散注意力者从正确转向错误的问题上,分散注意力者是所有三个基准上78-93%的案件中最不协调的句子(图3)。
因此,驱动正确答案的证据符合模型隐藏状态中的情况,而分散注意力者显然与模型不一致,即使模型遵循它。

blocks.en:

Figure 6 shows that the two methods perform similarly without additional remarks, but diverge once a remark is added.
With one added sentence, Excise outperforms Excise w/o IA by 7.2–10.0 accuracy points across three models, and the gap persists with further additions.

blocks.en:
The added-noise experiment highlights the role of attribution; we now examine how influence and discordance complement each other (Table 3 ).
Without the gate, blocking the top-attributed sentence in every question ( Excise w/o DG) costs 7.9–10.2 points on clean questions relative to no intervention, because in questions without a distractor this sentence is often a key clinical finding that fits the case.
Without attribution, Excise w/o IA reaches accuracy comparable to Excise , because in these benchmarks the distractor is usually the most discordant sentence (Section 4.2 ).
When another sentence is more discordant than the distractor, in 4.1–8.9% of flipped questions, Excise recovers most of them and Excise w/o IA almost none, since Excise w/o IA blocks the least fitting sentence whether or not it moves the decision (Figure 7 ).

blocks.en: 8.3 Where Does Excise Fail?
blocks.zh: 8.3 货物税失败在哪里?

blocks.en:
On flipped MedQA-TD questions, attribution ranks the distractor first in 90–91%; the gate passes it in 81–95% of these, and blocking it then restores the answer in 93–95% (Appendix E.5 ).
Overall, Excise recovers 71–81% of flipped questions, against 90–94% with the known distractor blocked.
The gate is the weakest step for MedQA-TD Bystander distractors, which it passes in 81–86% of questions, possibly because a relative’s medical history is closer to the case than other distractors are.
Attribution is the weakest step on MedDistractQA, where the distractor ranks first in only 72–89% of questions.

总的来说,消费税收回了71-81%被翻转的问题,而90-94 %被已知的分散注意力者堵住。

blocks.en: 9 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 9 结论

blocks.en:
We presented Excise , which selects the sentence that most influences a medical QA model’s answer and blocks attention to it only when the model’s own hidden states mark it as inconsistent with the case.
Unlike generation-based defenses that ask the model to identify or rewrite irrelevant content, Excise makes these decisions from measured intervention effects and hidden-state discordance.
blocks.zh:
只有在医疗质量评估模式本身的隐蔽状态标出与案件不符时,
与要求模型识别或重写不相干内容的以世代为基础的防御不同,克税通过测量的干预效应和隐藏状态的不和来做出这些决定.

blocks.en:
Our analysis showed that blocking a known distractor
largely restores accuracy, whereas fixed head masks
can suppress correct answers.
Hidden states also distinguish distractors even
when the model follows them.
blocks.zh:
我们的分析显示,阻止一个已知的分心者
基本恢复准确性,而固定头罩
可以压制正确的答案。
隐藏状态甚至还能区分分心者
当模型跟随他们。

blocks.en:
On MedQA-TD , Excise improves accuracy by 16.7–22.8 points at a 1.5–2.1-point cost on clean questions, with gains extending to other benchmarks and chain-of-thought generation.
Our ablations show that attribution helps locate the original distractor among additional off-case remarks, while the discordance gate limits harmful interventions on clean questions.
Together, these signals make intervention selective: Excise intervenes far more often when a distractor draws the model toward its targeted wrong option than when the answer remains correct despite its presence.
blocks.zh:
在MedQA-TD方面,货物税提高了16.7至22.8分的准确性,以1.5至2.1分的清洁问题成本,收益扩大到其他基准和思维链。
我们的谬论表明,归因有助于将最初的分心者定位在额外的非个案言论中,而不和之门限制了对干净问题的有害干预。
这些信号共同使干预具有选择性: 当一个分散注意力者将模型引向目标错误的选择时,其干预次数要多得多,而不是当答案尽管存在但仍是正确的时。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en:
Excise is designed to suppress information irrelevant to answering the question, rather than to correct false medical claims.
Fabricated rules, altered numerical values, and misleading guideline statements, such as those studied in MedMisBench ( Zhou et al., 2026 ) , require fact verification rather than ignoring and are outside its scope.
Our experiments focus on answer-preserving distractors in medical QA rather than the full range of noise encountered in clinical records.
Although Section 8.1 introduces additional off-case remarks, these do not capture transcription errors, speech-recognition artifacts, or duplicated text.
Moreover, each question contains only one answer-targeting distractor; the additional remarks are not designed to favor wrong options.
blocks.zh:
货物税旨在压制与回答问题无关的信息,而不是纠正虚假的医疗主张.
完善的规则,改变数字值,以及误导性的准则声明,如MedMis Bench(周等,2026年)所研究的,要求进行事实核实,而不是忽视,而且超出了其范围.
我们的实验集中在医学QA中保存分心器,而不是临床记录中遇到的全部噪音.
虽然第8.1节提出了额外的非个案说明,但这些说明没有记录抄录错误、语音识别文物或重复文本。
此外,每个问题只包含一个答案目标分辨器;附加语句的目的并非偏好错误的选项.

blocks.en:
Excise requires access to answer-option logits, attention, and hidden states.
It therefore applies to multiple-choice questions with white-box model access.
Although its decisions carry over to chain-of-thought generation (Table 2 ), questions without answer options are not covered.
The discordance gate also requires at least three narrative sentences; shorter questions are left unchanged.
blocks.zh:
货物税要求获得答案选项记录、注意力和隐藏状态。
因此,它适用于带有白盒模型访问的多选择问题.
虽然其决定延续到思维链生成(表2),但没有答案的问题则不包括在内。
不和之门也至少需要三个叙事句;更短的问题保持不变.

blocks.en:
The gate estimates a mean and first principal component from the unlabeled inputs to which it is applied.
This batch-dependent projection can be difficult to estimate when questions arrive individually or when suitable batches cannot be gathered.
A projection fixed on development data avoids this requirement, but retains a smaller accuracy gain (Appendix E.1 ).
blocks.zh:
大门从未加标签的投入中估算出一个平均和第一个主要组成部分。
这种依赖批量的预测可能难以估计何时问题分别到达,或何时无法收集适当的批量。
固定在开发数据上的预测避免了这一要求,但保留了较小的精度增益(附录E.1.

blocks.en:
Excise uses 3 ​ n + 1 3n+1 forward passes per question: one answer readout, n n attribution passes, and 2 ​ n 2n short passes for the discordance gate.
On MedQA-TD , this amounts to about 25 passes and 721–819 ms per question, approximately 18–20 times the latency of a single pass.
The method also reduces accuracy on clean MedQA questions by 1.5–2.1 points (Table 2 ), reflecting the remaining risk of unnecessary intervention.
blocks.zh:
货物税使用每题3n+1 3n+1前传通行证:一发答读出,一发n归属通行证;二发n 2n短通行证为相和门.
在MedQA-TD上,这相当于每个问题大约25个通行证和721至819毫秒,大约是单个通行证的间隔的18至20倍.
该方法还使干净的MedQA问题的准确性降低了1.5–2.1分(表2),反映了剩余的不必要的干预风险.

blocks.en: Ethical Considerations
blocks.zh: 道德考虑

blocks.en:
MedQA-TD consists of synthetic distractors written by GPT-OSS-120B ( Agarwal et al., 2025 ) for public MedQA questions and contains no patient data.
Available dataset and model licenses are listed in Appendix A . Excise is an analysis and mitigation method for benchmark settings.
It is not validated for clinical use, and its clean cost and remaining errors mean that it must not be deployed for patient care without clinical evaluation.
blocks.zh:
MeDQA-TD由GPT-OSS-120B(Agarwal等,2025年)为公众的MeDQA问题所撰写的合成分心器组成,并不含患者数据.
附录A列出了现有的数据集和示范许可证。 货物税是基准设置的一种分析和缓解方法。
它未经临床使用验证,其清洁成本和剩余出错意味着,未经临床评估,不得用于病人护理。

blocks.en: B.1 Human Review of MedQA-TD Questions
blocks.zh: B.1 对医疗QA-TD问题的人类审查

blocks.en:
The two reviewers are PhD students in a geriatric epidemiology laboratory of a medical school, working on clinical cohort studies, and neither took part in building MedQA-TD .
Both reviewers volunteered.
They judged 100 test questions sampled at random, 50 of each distractor type, independently, and each answered two questions for each: whether the inserted sentence changes which option is correct, and whether a clinician would use it as evidence for the question.
Neither reviewer answered yes to either question.
For the second question, they answered possibly for 1 and 4 cases, with one case in common.
They agreed on all 100 cases for the first question and on 97 for the second (Gwet’s AC1 0.97; Gwet, 2008 ), and we do not report Cohen’s kappa ( Cohen, 1960 ) , which becomes uninformative when almost all answers fall into one category ( Feinstein and Cicchetti, 1990 ) .
blocks.zh:
两名审查员是一所医学院老年流行病学实验室的博士生,从事临床组群研究,他们都没有参与建立医学质量评估-TD。
两位审查员都自愿参加。
他们分别对随机抽取的100个测试问题进行了判断,每分辨出一种类型的50个测试问题,每个测试问题分别回答两个问题:所插入的句子是否改变哪个选项是正确的,以及临床医生是否会将其作为问题的证据.
两位审查人员都没有回答任何问题。
对于第二个问题,他们可能回答1起和4起,有一个案件是共同的。
他们同意了第一个问题和第二个问题的所有100个案例(Gwet的AC1 0.97;Gwet,2008年),我们不报告科恩的卡帕(Cohen,1960年),当几乎所有的答案都属于一个类别(Feinstein和Cicchetti,1990年)时,卡帕就变得不灵了。

blocks.en:
Figure 9 analyzes what makes a distractor of MedQA-TD strong for Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and Qwen3-8B.
First, distractors flip most often the questions on which the model was already torn between the gold and the targeted option before the distractor was added.
Among questions answered correctly without the distractor, 57–78% of those in the quartile with the smallest clean margin between the two options flip to the target, against 10–25% in the quartile with the largest margin (Figure 9 (a)).
Second, the targeted option and the phrasing of the selected distractor each lower accuracy further than a distractor drawn at random from the same candidates (Figure 9 (b)).
Each of the two steps lowers accuracy by 3.5–6.1 points for both models and both distractor types, with every 95% interval below zero.
Third, the selected phrasings push toward the target even without the case (Figure 9 (c)).
blocks.zh:
图9分析了对Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct和Qune3-8B而言,MedQA-TD的分心器是强的。
首先,分心器在被添加分心器之前,最经常地翻转已经将模型撕裂到金子和被目标选项之间的问题.
在没有分心者正确回答的问题中,57%至78%的四分位数在两个选项之间净差最小,倒向目标,而10%至25%的四分位数在最大(图9(a))。
第二,目标选项和选定分流器的用词比从同一候选人随机抽取的分流器更准确(图9(b))。
两个步骤中的每一步都使两种模型和两种分心器类型的精度降低3.5-6.1分,每95%的间隔会低于零.
第三,选定的用词即使没有案例也向目标推进(图9(c))。

blocks.en:
To analyze position bias, MedQA-TD comes in three versions, with the distractor at the end of the narrative (as built, where it is the last narrative sentence in 97% of questions), in its middle or as its first sentence.
In the middle and first versions, Excise still gains 6.8–16.4 points, whereas blocking the last narrative sentence lowers accuracy by 4.9–9.1 points (Table 5 ).
Where a benchmark itself places the cue early in the case, as the second narrative sentence (BiasMedQA confirmation), Excise gains 14.8 points for Qwen3-8B and is within 1.3 points of no intervention for Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and Llama-3-Meerkat-8B.
Table 6 gives every method at the three positions. The accuracy of Excise varies by at most 3.2 points across positions, so its gain is smaller where the distractor is less harmful; averaged attention with the gate varies by up to 13.4 points, falling from the end to the first position for Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and Llama-3-Meerkat-8B and rising for Qwen3-8B, and ContextCite with the gate stays within 1.6 points of Excise at every position.
Selecting the sentence by its effect under blocking, as Excise and ContextCite do, is therefore insensitive to its position, unlike selecting it by attention.
Without intervention, every one of the nine models is least accurate with the distractor at the end, 4.1–10.5 points below the middle or first position (Table 7 ).

blocks.en: D.2 Head Masks
blocks.zh: D.2 头罩

blocks.en:
We follow the differentiable head masking of Niu et al. (2025) in the sentence-level form of Liu and Chu (2026) .
A continuous mask on every attention head is trained to lower the target-minus-gold logit gap on MedQA-TD pairs, with a KL term that keeps the output on the clean question and a sparsity weight λ \lambda that keeps few heads removed.
blocks.zh:
我们跟随尼乌等(2025年)不同的头相遮相,以"刘"和"朱"(2026年)的句子级别形式出现.
在每个注意力头上都训练出一个连续的口罩来降低MedQA-TD对上的目标-减去-黄金的对数差距,其中KL术语将输出保留在干净的问题上,而Sparsity重量QQ\lambda则保留了很少的头被去掉.

blocks.en:
The masks are trained on the Bystander and Nonliteral pairs of 382 development questions, using only the pairs that the unmasked model answers correctly without the distractor and with the targeted option with it.
We search the learning rate in { 0.03 , 0.1 , 0.3 } \{0.03,0.1,0.3\} and λ \lambda in { 1 , 2 } \{1,2\} , train for 200 epochs, keep a mask every 10 epochs and then every epoch around the best one, which gives up to 130 candidates per model.
We pick the candidate with the highest mean of MedQA-TD Bystander and Nonliteral accuracy on the other 887 development questions among those whose clean accuracy stays within 2 points of the unmasked model.
Only OLMo-2-7B-Instruct had such a candidate, so for the other four models we used the one with the highest mean of this MedQA-TD accuracy and clean accuracy.
The gold-cue control uses the MedQA-TD construction with the distractor pointing at the correct option instead of a wrong one (same generator, judge, insertion rule and questions; one candidate drawn at random among those that evoke only the correct option).
For each tuned mask, five control masks remove the same number of heads from each layer, chosen uniformly at random within the layer, and are read on every set.
Table 11 gives the accuracy of every mask on each set. In all five models, the selected masks lie above all five random masks on clean and MedQA-TD questions. On the gold-cue control they lie below all five in nine of the ten model and distractor-type cells, and within the random range for Llama-3-Meerkat-8B Nonliteral.

blocks.en: Interventional Attribution resolves a specific ambiguity that discordance alone cannot (Table 14 ; Section 8.2 ). Among the flipped questions pooled across MedQA-TD , MedDistractQA, and BiasMedQA, the distractor passes the gate but is not the most discordant sentence in 254 of 3,846 Qwen questions and 80 of 1,928 Llama questions. blocks.en: E.4 Added Off-Case Sentences
blocks.zh: E.4 增加的结案判决

blocks.en:
For each MedQA-TD test question, we insert the distractor of another question of the same type (Nonliteral or Bystander), chosen at random among those that share no content word with any of the question’s options.
Content words are words of at least four letters other than stop words, and two words count as shared when their first five letters match, following the five-letter truncation of McNamee et al. (2009) , so that, for example, “fracture” and “fractured” match.
The added sentence is inserted at a random position after the first sentence and before the question’s own distractor, which stays where it is in the main experiments.
The sets with two and three added sentences each add one further sentence to the previous set, chosen and inserted in the same way.
We exclude 47 Nonliteral questions whose options contain “patient”, which appears in nearly all Nonliteral distractors and leaves no eligible off-case remark that shares no content word with the options.
We also exclude 18 Nonliteral and 19 Bystander questions with at most one sentence before the original distractor, leaving no valid insertion position.
This leaves 1,208 Nonliteral and 1,254 Bystander questions in every set.
With one added sentence, blocking the added sentence alone changes the answer about as often as blocking an ordinary sentence of the case (10–14% against 8–10% of questions) and far less often than blocking the distractor (31–42%), indicating that the added sentence has a much smaller effect on the model’s decision.
All models use the hyperparameters of Table 9 , and the gate’s projection is estimated from each set’s own sentences as in the main experiments.
blocks.zh:
对于每个MedQA-TD测试问题,我们插入另一个同类型问题的分心器(Nonliteral或旁观者),在那些与问题的任何选择没有内容单词的人中随机选择。
内容词指除止词外,至少有四个字母的词;在McNamee等人(2009年)的取出5个字母后,两个词在前5个字母相匹配时算作共有,因此,例如,“分解”和“分解”相匹配。
添加的句子被插入到第一句后和问题本身的分心者之前的随机位置上,它停留在主实验中的位置.
加上了两句和三句的套子,每句都以同样的方式与上一组相加一句,选择并插入.
我们排除了47个非文学问题,这些问题的选择包含“病人”,这些问题几乎出现在所有非文学的分散注意力者中,并且没有留下任何合格的非个案评论,这些评论与选择没有共同的内容。
我们还排除了18个Nonliteral和19个旁观者的问题,最多在最初的分心者之前用一句话,从而没有留下有效的插入位置.
这使得每集有1,208个非文学题和1,254个旁观者题.

blocks.en:
Table 15 gives the results.
Without intervention, accuracy rises by 3.6–6.9 points from zero to three added sentences, as the added sentences weaken the distractor’s influence: the share of answers selecting its target option falls by 5.7–9.4 points, and the distractor’s median attribution score falls by half or more.
In the same setting, the attention that the answer position pays to the distractor, averaged over layers and heads, falls by 22–32% from zero to three added sentences for every model and distractor type.
Across questions, a larger fall from zero to one added sentence is correlated with a larger fall in the target-minus-gold logit gap (Spearman’s ρ \rho 0.18–0.37 ( Spearman, 1904 ) , with lower bounds of the 95% bootstrap intervals of 0.12–0.32).

在同一背景下,答案位置对分心器的注意,平均分层和头部,从0到3个附加句子,每个模型和分心器类型都下降了22-32%.
纵观所有问题,从零降为一加一的句子与目标-减去-黄金对数差距(Spearman's $\rho 0.18-0.37 (Spearman, 1904 )) 的较大下降相关,95%的靴子间隔为0.12-0.32。

For each noise level, flipped questions are those answered correctly on the original clean question but incorrectly on the corresponding augmented question.
The denominator is recomputed at each noise level and includes questions without intervention.
With one, two and three added sentences, Excise blocks the original distractor in 54–80%, 41–67% and 35–64% of flipped questions.

blocks.en: E.5 When Excise Intervenes
blocks.zh: E.5 联合国 消费干预时

blocks.en:
Excise responds to the distractor’s effect on the answer, not to its presence (Table 16 ; Section 8.2 ).
It intervenes on 79–94% of the questions whose answer the distractor pulled to the target, on 25–38% of the other wrong answers and on 8–22% of the correct ones.
On questions answered correctly both with and without the distractor, it intervenes less often with the distractor (7–21%) than on their clean versions (19–30%).
The answers pulled to the target differ between the two models (Jaccard 0.35–0.36), and Excise w/o IA intervenes on 92–99% of all questions (Table 3 ), so its intervention carries no such information.

blocks.en:
S2A answers from its rewrite with the same first-token readout, and Table 21 gives its accuracy with the share of rewrites that keep the distractor. Figure 10 relates the gain of S2A to whether the rewrite keeps the distractor.
For Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and Qwen3-8B, chain-of-thought generation uses the system and user messages of the answer readout (Appendix G ) without the fixed assistant prefix, and the answer is read from the generated JSON object’s “answer” field.
All chain-of-thought outputs are decoded greedily with at most 1,024 new tokens.
For BiasMedQA, whose questions have five options, the instruction lists the letters A to E. The MMLU-PM and MedDistractQA columns of Qwen3-8B and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and all of Llama-3-Meerkat-8B’s are decoded with the key-value cache, which gives the same answer as decoding without it for 92–93% of 100 MedQA-TD questions for Qwen3-8B and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct (accuracy within 2 points) and for all of 10 questions for Llama-3-Meerkat-8B. Llama-3-Meerkat-8B ignores the shared JSON answer format, so it is prompted with the system message of its model card (Appendix G ) and its answer is read from the last “the answer is (X)”, which is also accepted without the opening parenthesis. The same rule reads every Llama-3-Meerkat-8B row. It reads 93–98% of the CoT + I 3 C answers and at least 98.9% of the other answers. Requiring the parenthesis would lower CoT + I 3 C by 2.7–5.1 points and leave the other rows unchanged. Its I 3 C verifications follow the requested format in 37% of cases (Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct: 99%), so its CoT + I 3 C row shows I 3 C applied to a model that rarely completes the verification step.
Applied to the model’s own S2A rewrite, Excise stays within 1.7 points of the better single method in every MedQA-TD cell of Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, Qwen3-8B and Phi-4 and inherits the clean cost of Excise (Table 21 ).

"The patient said their friend’s business is hemorrhaging money after a bad investment." 3. "The patient mentioned that their new car has a transmission fluid leak." 4. "The patient’s professor delivered a lecture about the heart of ancient civilizations." ## Medical Question: {question} ## Clinical topic: {clinical_topic} Generate one sentence using a medical term related to the clinical topic, where clinical terminology is used as nonmedical meaning. The statement should NOT affect the diagnostic process or decision-making for the medical question in any meaningful way. It should not convey any medical information or symptomatic information. Avoid including any information that could mislead clinical reasoning. Always begin with "The patient said that" or "The patient joked that" and use a clinical term figuratively to describe a nonmedical subject--not the reverse. Do not generate the following examples or similar statements that assert physiological effects or patient symptoms, bodily states, or test findings, even as jokes: - "The patient joked that the office coffee was so strong it could boost LH levels faster than a morning workout." This asserts a physiological effect on LH levels. - "The patient joked that her coffee’s ’Rinne test’ was always abnormal, because the espresso sounded louder in the left ear than the right." This introduces a difference in the patient’s hearing between the two ears. Only respond with the confounding sentence.
